Validators reference 3 different resource-group names (rg-fabric, rg-fabric-challenge, rg-fabricdataquality). They should all target the same lab resource group — reconcile them (prefer a CloudLabs inject placeholder over a hardcoded name).

The ARM template deploys microsoft.keyvault/vaults, microsoft.containerregistry/registries, microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts, microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts/deployments, microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces, but the custom RBAC role's Actions never allow these providers/types — the deployment can fail with an authorization error. Add "microsoft.keyvault/vaults/write", "microsoft.containerregistry/registries/write", "microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts/write", "microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts/deployments/write", "microsoft.machinelearningservices/workspaces/write" (or the provider wildcard, e.g. "microsoft.keyvault/*") to the role's Actions.

The template deploys a virtual machine but no auto-shutdown schedule — the VM keeps billing after the session ends. Add a Microsoft.DevTestLab/schedules resource per VM (taskType "ComputeVmShutdownTask", name "shutdown-computevm-<vmName>") with a dailyRecurrence time.

issues.message: The guide says a Microsoft Fabric / Power BI item (workspace, lakehouse, warehouse, semantic model) is pre-seeded, but ARM/Bicep cannot create control-plane objects and no artifact seeds them via the service REST API (api.fabric.microsoft.com / api.powerbi.com). Either (a) make the learner create the items as explicit exercise tasks (guide + validations must match), or (b) add a bootstrap that seeds them through the REST API with an auth token — only then may the guide say "pre-seeded".
